newsitem.title: USA: 7th Level creates office of the president.
newsitem.headline: 7th Level creates office of the president.

text.p: 7th Level Inc said Monday it has created a new Office of the President, with Doug Gillespie, Jeff Croson, and Paul Bodnoff sharing the office.

Gillespie, the senior vice president of research and development; Jeff Croson, senior vice president of sales; and Paul Bodnoff, vice president of marketing; also will continue in their respective roles, the company said.
7th Level, a computer game company, also said it is formulating a new business plan which is expected to be in place by the early summer 1997.
